items.title: Crossing the Threshold: How OpenAI and Anthropic Approach Autonomy and Safety in Financial Agents
items.summary: OpenAI’s Joseph Kim talks about the threshold phenomenon at AIE NY today. One of the key themes at the AI Engineer New York conference this week was how to balance agent autonomy with security and safety . Both frontier labs and financial firms focused on this issue in their presentations this week. The main lesson: safe autonomy depends on where you put controls and human judgment , rather than how many restrictions

items.title: Linus Torvalds's first LLM-assisted patch series
items.summary: Article URL: https://lwn.net/Articles/1100449/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50090842 Points: 122 # Comments: 110
items.summaryZh: 在近期举行的Maintainers峰会上，Linux内核创始人Linus Torvalds透露，他一直在使用大语言模型来开发一组解决长期存在问题的补丁，并已将该系列补丁提交以供审查。这组包含十个补丁的短系列主要通过识别热点folio、在RCU期后延迟释放folio等机制来增强folio查找，从而在读取密集型基准测试中实现了数量级的性能提升。审查过程也发现了其中的竞争条件，表明后续仍需改进。这凸显了大模型在复杂开源系统内核维护和真实工程开发中的实际参与度。

items.summaryZh: 针对大语言模型在生成网页和UI时存在的审美趋同与多样性崩溃问题，研究者推出了Design Creativity Bench基准。该基准评估了16个前沿模型在80个开放式UI设计任务中的原创性、创造性范围和适当性表现。测试结果显示，最佳前沿模型距离人类设计师的整体创造性评分仍有显著差距，并公开了完整的排行榜与开源评估框架。

items.title: Deploy and evaluate models with Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
items.summary: Choosing the right model for a specific application requires a practical way to test it with representative inputs. Amazon SageMaker JumpStart provides access to a broad catalog of already pretrained models. In this post, we show how to deploy an available model from SageMaker JumpStart, run a lightweight and repeatable performance test using the SageMaker Python SDK, and delete the endpoint when testing is complete.
